intro.fr: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: MercurySteam sort Castlevania: Lords of Shadow en 2010.
text.en: MercurySteam releases Castlevania: Lords of Shadow in 2010.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Haywire32/LoS-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Castlevania: Lords of Shadow.
text.en: The GitHub repository Haywire32/LoS-Archipelago, home of the Castlevania: Lords of Shadow APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.5.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.5.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.7.4, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (8 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.7.4 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (8 versions released).

text.fr: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
